name: H&H Metal Fabrication
old_description: Engineering teams, project managers, and procurement buyers trust H&H to take a tight spec and fabricate it into something that ships when we say it will. St. Louis-based, serving customers across the region and beyond since 1947.
about:
H&H Metal Fabrication has operated from St. Louis, Missouri since 1947, when the Finazzo family began manufacturing light fixtures in the same building that housed the H&H radio shop. The company remained under continuous family ownership for more than seven decades before transitioning in 2019 to women-owned leadership under Carolyn Farrell (President) and Morgan Jarrett (COO), with Kevin Farrell serving as CFO.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication built to print, including electrical enclosures, e-houses, and enclosure modification services such as cut-outs, drilling, and threading. A 500-ton, 22-foot press brake anchors the forming capacity at their downtown plant on South 22nd Street, and full in-house painting capabilities support finish requirements. The team handles one-off prototypes as well as repeat production runs for larger assemblies.

Customers range from engineering firms and procurement buyers to electrical contractors and manufacturers. Notable projects include fabricating the attachment mechanism for the Chihuly Blue Chandelier reinstallation at the Missouri Botanical Garden, supplying light housings for the new exterior lighting at St. Louis City Hall, and supporting lighting projects for Villa Lighting Supply across the U.S. and Canada.

The company emphasizes quality craftsmanship and first-class customer service as its founding standards, maintained through the ownership transition. WBENC certification as a Women's Business Enterprise provides a procurement advantage for clients with supplier-diversity requirements.
